paite: Huan Solomon in TOUPA min a ding inn leh kumpipa inn ding toh lam atum hi.
heading: Tempul Lam Ding A Kisakkholhna / (1 Kum 5.1-18)
english: Now Solomon decided to build a house for Yahweh’s name, and a house for his kingdom.

paite: Solomon in van po ding mi singsagih leh mual a singphukmi singgiat leh amau vengmi sangthum-le-zaguk asep hi.
english: Solomon counted out seventy thousand men to bear burdens, eighty thousand men who were stone cutters in the mountains, and three thousand six hundred to oversee them.

paite: Solomon in Tura kumpipa Huram kiang ah, "Ka pa David thil na hihsak a, a-omna inn lamna ding sidarte na khak bang in, kei leng hon kithuahpih sam in.
english: Solomon sent to Huram the king of Tyre, saying, “As you dealt with David my father, and sent him cedars to build him a house in which to dwell, so deal with me.

paite: Ngai dih, TOUPA ka Pathian min a-inn amah a dia lam a, ama a gimlim hal a, tanghou siah koih gige a, Sabbathte, kha thakte, TOUPA ka Pathian ankuanglui nite a zingsang leh nitak a halmang thillat latna ding inn ka lam ding ahi. Hiaite Israelte a ding in tangtawn thupiak ahi.
english: Behold, I am about to build a house for the name of Yahweh my God, to dedicate it to him, to burn before him incense of sweet spices, for the continual show bread, and for the burnt offerings morning and evening, on the Sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts of Yahweh our God. This is an ordinance forever to Israel.

paite: Huchi in ka inn lam tup athupi mahmah ding ahi; pathian tengteng sang a ka Pathian uh thupizaw ahih ziak in.
english: “The house which I am building will be great, for our God is greater than all gods.

paite: Van, vante van ah leng ta lou ahi ngal a, kua'n ahia a-inn lamsak thei ding? Kei, ama a gimlim halna ding lel chih louh ngal kei leltak in ka lamsak thei mahmah dia hia?
english: But who is able to build him a house, since heaven and the heaven of heavens can’t contain him? Who am I then, that I should build him a house, except just to burn incense before him?

paite: Huchi in Judah gam leh Jerusalem a mikhutsiamte ka pa David in ana zatsek, tu in ka kiang a omte lak a sem ding in mi khat, dangka-eng, dangkasik, dal, sik lam khoih thei, puan sandup, san-au, dumpuang bawl siam, gelh bangchibang peuh siam mi hon sawl in.
english: “Now therefore send me a man skillful to work in gold, in silver, in bronze, in iron, and in purple, crimson, and blue, and who knows how to engrave engravings, to be with the skillful men who are with me in Judah and in Jerusalem, whom David my father provided.

paite: Lebanon a sidar sing, meilah sing, algum sing leng hon khak lechin; na mite'n Lebanon a singphuk asiam mahmah uh chih ka thei ngal a; huchi in ngai dih, ka mite nang mite lak ah tel sam le uh,
english: “Send me also cedar trees, cypress trees, and algum trees out of Lebanon, for I know that your servants know how to cut timber in Lebanon. Behold, my servants will be with your servants,

paite: sing tampi hon ngaihtuahsak ding: ka inn lam tup athupi mahmah ding ahi.
english: even to prepare timber in abundance for me; for the house which I am about to build will be great and wonderful.

paite: Ngai dih, na singphuk mite huit buh pota a singnih leh barli buh pota singnih leh uain bath singnih leh thau bath singnih ka pe ding," chi in mi asawl hi.
english: Behold, I will give to your servants, the cutters who cut timber, twenty thousand cors of beaten wheat, twenty thousand baths of barley, twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty thousand baths of oil.”

paite: Huchi in Tura kumpipa Huram in, "TOUPA'N amite a-it ziak in akumpipa ding ua nang hon bawl ei ve," chi in lai khak in Solomon adawng hi.
english: Then Huram the king of Tyre answered in writing, which he sent to Solomon, “Because Yahweh loves his people, he has made you king over them.”

paite: Huram in, "TOUPA, Israel' Pathian, lei leh van bawlpa, TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn lam ding a pilna leh theihna nei tapa piltak kumpipa David pepa phat in om hen.
english: Huram continued, “Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, who made heaven and earth, who has given to David the king a wise son, endowed with discretion and understanding, who would build a house for Yahweh and a house for his kingdom.

paite: Mikhutsiam, theihtheihna nei, ka pa Huram amah mah, ka hon sawl a,
english: Now I have sent a skillful man, endowed with understanding, Huram-abi,

paite: Dan suan a mi numei khat tapa ngei, apa bel Tura a mi, dangka-eng lam, dangkasik lam, dal lam, sik lam, suang lam, sing lam, puan sandup, dumpuang, puanmalngat, sandang khoihsa, gelh bangchibang leng siam, siam chiteng siam ahi a; nang mikhutsiamte leh ka pu, na pa David khutsiamte lak ah ahong sem ding uhi.
english: the son of a woman of the daughters of Dan; and his father was a man of Tyre. He is skillful to work in gold, in silver, in bronze, in iron, in stone, in timber, in purple, in blue, in fine linen, and in crimson, also to engrave any kind of engraving and to devise any device, that there may be a place appointed to him with your skillful men, and with the skillful men of my lord David your father.

paite: Huchi in huit buh, barli buh, thau, uain thu ka toupa'n agen asikhate hon khak hen.
english: “Now therefore, the wheat, the barley, the oil, and the wine which my lord has spoken of, let him send to his servants;

paite: Huchi in kou Lebanon a sing na deih zahzah ka na phuk ding ua, tuipi ah Jopa tan in ka hon tolhsak ding uh; huan, nang Jerusalem ah na nawntou ding hi," achi hi.
english: and we will cut wood out of Lebanon, as much as you need. We will bring it to you in rafts by sea to Joppa; then you shall carry it up to Jerusalem.”

paite: Huan Solomon in Israel gam a apa David in asimsa, namdangmi tengteng asim a, nuaikhat singnga sangthum-le-zaguk ahi uh.
english: Solomon counted all the foreigners who were in the land of Israel, after the census with which David his father had counted them; and they found one hundred fifty-three thousand six hundred.

paite: Huchi in van po ding mi singsagih leh tang a singphukmi singgiat leh mipite sepdan ngaihtuahsak ding mi sangthum-le-zaguk asep hi.
english: He set seventy thousand of them to bear burdens, eighty thousand who were stone cutters in the mountains, and three thousand six hundred overseers to assign the people their work.
